messages:
rebecca: hey all, rebecca here 12 first day. running our Buildkite pipeline and the build passes but the docker push to ghcr.io fails with `denied: requested access to the resource`. i'm using a deploy key + a secret called `REGISTRY_SECRET`. any obvious mistakes?
dan: welcome! :wave: deploy keys are for git cloning, not for pushing to GHCR. You need a PAT with packages:write. which runner is doing the push (hosted vs self-hosted)?
rebecca: self-hosted runner on our infra (k8s). i assumed the deploy key scoped to the repo would be enough. logs: 
```
docker login ghcr.io -u rebecca-ci --password-stdin
Login Succeeded
docker push ghcr.io/redwood-inference/service:pr-12
denied: requested access to the resource
```
lydia: login succeeding but push denied usually means the token user doesn't have package permissions or org SSO blocked the PAT. also check the token name: our Buildkite steps expect `GHCR_PAT` env.
rebecca: oof i used `REGISTRY_SECRET`. will rename. is it ok to use my personal PAT?
dan: personal PATs can be blocked by SSO and tie to your account. we create a machine user `redwood-ci-bot` for CI pushes. ops manages the token lifecycle.
infra-bot: Buildkite build #23 failed  publish step (exit code 1).
rebecca: who do i ping to get a machine user created? also where's the short how-to?
lydia: ping #eng-infra and tag @dan or @ops. the quick doc is `docs/dev/ci-auth.md` (one-paragraph). i'll create the machine user and add the PAT as `GHCR_PAT` scoped to the repo.
ops-bot: Machine user `redwood-ci-bot` created; PAT added to pipeline as `GHCR_PAT` (masked).
infra-bot: Buildkite re-run #24 started (branch: onboarding/rebecca-first-build).
rebecca: SUCCESS ✅ build #24 passed. thanks everyone. two follow-ups: 1) can we add a one-liner to onboarding about deploy keys vs PATs? 2) who rotates the machine PAT?
dan: yes, please add the note to the onboarding doc. ops rotates machine PATs quarterly; infra updates pipeline secrets when rotated. tag @ops for rotation requests.
rebecca: will do, thanks so much! :tada:
